name: MFA Challenge Failures
description: When the password works but MFA is denied or timed out, the attacker has the first factor and is guessing or spamming the second. That is a near-compromise: one more successful prompt and they are in. Fatigue attacks look like a burst of denied MFA on one user. Privileged accounts with repeated MFA failures after a correct password should be locked until the user confirms they started the login.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
